about: Norton IB6 India combination bench stone, 152.4 x 50.8 x 25.4 mm, modelled from scratch lying flat with its fine face up, as the placeholder: one closed aluminium-oxide block, the fine grit's half an orange tan, the coarse grit's half below it a darker grey-brown, each half the thickness, their bonded joint a slightly ragged line round the sides, every outside edge broken 1 mm (none at the joint); a dry, matte grain from the shared rubber tile, the coarse half's coarser and deeper.
reviewed: 2026-11-06: draft; checked against Norton's product photograph of the IB6 with its box (hardwareworld.com, item TVE3U2) for the grits' colours and the joint, and the record's dimensions and the placeholder's box; the look sheets and the page-side renders (loadcheck: front, close) reviewed, the rendered sides' colours sampled against the photograph's

bstone_fine.about: fine India (aluminium oxide): an orange tan, matte, a fine even grain; saturated past the photograph's so the environment's sheen at a glancing view leaves it orange

bstone_coarse.about: coarse India: a darker grey-brown, drier, its grain coarser and deeper

unsure.what: the coarse half's colour: the record says only that the fine face is the lighter orange; Norton's photograph shows the coarse half a dark grey-brown, which this follows
the grain is the shared rubber tile scaled down (as gwheel's abrasive is), not a photographed stone texture
